title: Site Exclusivity and Multiple Holdings under the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
A client may hold as many Workplace Cafe Management Program contracts as it has sites, and there is no ceiling on the number held at once. Each contract is written against exactly one site, and every fee, subsidy lot and invoice belongs to that site's contract alone. Where the client wants a second dining outlet inside a site already under contract, that outlet is added to the existing contract as a further serving station rather than opened as a second contract.

**Exclusivity at the site.** A further cafe management contract is not opened for a site that already carries an open cafe management contract. A site's contract counts as open while it stands proposed, mobilizing, active, suspended or in transition out, and counts as gone once it is closed, so a site whose earlier contract has closed may be reopened on a fresh contract.

**How the check reads the records.** The exclusivity check is made against the system's own contract records held for the client and the site together, read before the new contract is opened — the client's own account of what it already holds does not settle the question on its own. A contract already on record for that same client at that same site, standing in any of the states named above, blocks the opening of a further one; a record showing that earlier contract as closed does not block it.

**Holding limits.** No ceiling at all is placed on the number of sites, and so the number of contracts, that a single client may hold. At most 1 open cafe management contract is carried for a given site at any one time.
